system.description:
Flurry Technique

Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of the Attack action or a Bukijutsu you cast, you can spend 2 Discipline to release a mighty roar, boasting of your strength, vigor or just belittling your enemy. All hostile creatures in a 20-foot cone originating for you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they shift their focus to you. Until the beginning of your next turn, creatures have disadvantage on their next attack if you aren’t their target. If they would instead force a saving throw, creatures that aren’t you gain a rank of Mastery to that saving throw.
